text:
Ravi S.: Quick proposal: tighten SIEM export access and KMS unwrap flows after last week's vuln triage. Goals: minimize long-lived creds, require ticketed approvals for unwraps, and add anomaly alerts. Draft policy below.

Maya - oncall: Strong +1. Can you summarize how this affects downstream consumers (partners, analytics)?

Ravi S.: Short answer: nothing changes for retention or exported payload shape. Change is only auth: - Export tokens: rotate on 7d cadence (automated) - Backward compatibility: proxy accepts previous token for 10d with header `X-Old-Token: accepted` - KMS unwrap: JIT approval window 60m, requires `ticket_id` + `approver` in unwrap request - Emergency SOC bypass: timeboxed (max 4h), requires two approvers and auto-audited entry.

DevOps / Infra: Implementation notes: we can add middleware in export-proxy to validate token version and perform KMS unwrap via a short-lived decrypt role. Sketch: 
```
# pseudo logic
if token.age <= 7d and token.sig valid: allow
elif token.age <= 17d and header X-Old-Token == 'accepted': allow but mark warning
else: reject
```
Also add metric `siem.unwrap.requests` with labels {key_id, requester_role}.

Maya - oncall: For rollout, prefer canary: enable on staging, then `eng-test` consumers, then prod with 48h observation. Need a consumer health endpoint (200 OK + last-export-ts).

Legal - Anna: Compliance note: auditors will need an immutable record of who approved each unwrap and the related ticket reference. Also redact PII from exported logs by default; if someone requests unmask, record reason and duration.

Ravi S.: Good catch — will add `reason` and `duration` fields in unwrap audit events. Events stored to secure audit bucket (SSE-KMS) and forwarded to SOC SIEM with tag `audit:unwrap`. Retention of audit events remains 7y per retention policy.

DevOps / Infra: Alerting: create rule to page if `unwrap_count(key_id) > 3 in 10m` OR `unwrap_by_single_user > 5 in 1h`. Add a Grafana panel for unwrap spikes.

Maya - oncall: How do we handle consumers that cache tokens? Many of our partners cache creds for a week. If token rotates they will fail. Suggest we publish a deprecation header and a public migration email + SDK upgrade.

Ravi S.: Action items: - DevOps: PR for proxy middleware + metrics/alerts - Maya: test plan & consumer healthcheck endpoints - Anna: draft compliance wording for auditors and sample audit CSV format - Ravi: update RFC and add runbook for `soc-bypass` steps

SOC Bot: Runbook created: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/security/siem-access-rotation (roles, approvers, rollback steps).

Maya - oncall: I'll validate the runbook during next oncall shift and run a rehearsal in staging.

Ravi S.: Thanks. I'll open RFC-SEC-2026 and tag folks. Posting a sample unwrap payload for infra to wire into logging: 

```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-23T12:34:56Z","requester":"maya","role":"soc:incident","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd-1234","ticket_id":"SEC-2026","approver":"ravi","reason":"forensic triage","duration_mins":60}
```

DevOps / Infra: Note - ensure unwrap logs are write-once and access-controlled. We'll implement bucket-level object lock + CMK encryption.

Maya - oncall: Ping me when PR is ready and I'll run the staging rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
